# awscc_kinesisanalyticsv2_snapshot (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::KinesisAnalyticsV2::Snapshot, a point-in-time snapshot of a Managed Service for Apache Flink (Kinesis Analytics V2) application's state. Snapshots are account-scoped and immutable: every input property except Tags is create-only, so changing any of them forces replacement, while changing Tags updates the snapshot in place. Specify exactly one source: ApplicationName to snapshot a running application (CreateSnapshot), or ImportSourceConfiguration to import a snapshot from Amazon S3 (ImportSnapshot). CloudFormation deletes the snapshot via DeleteSnapshot; to retain a snapshot beyond the stack, set DeletionPolicy: Retain on the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `snapshot_name` (String) The customer-chosen name of the snapshot, unique within the account. Immutable after create.

### Optional

- `application_name` (String) The name of the Managed Service for Apache Flink application to snapshot. Used only at create time to select the source application; immutable after create. Specify either ApplicationName or ImportSourceConfiguration, not both.
- `import_source_configuration` (Attributes) The Amazon S3 location and role to import the snapshot from, with ImportSnapshot. Used only at create time; immutable after create. Specify either ApplicationName or ImportSourceConfiguration, not both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--import_source_configuration))
- `snapshot_description` (String) Optional customer-supplied description of the snapshot. Immutable after create.
- `snapshot_encryption_configuration_description` (Attributes) The encryption of the snapshot. Can be set only with ImportSourceConfiguration (sent as the ImportSnapshot DestinationEncryptionConfiguration; the AWS owned key when omitted). A snapshot taken from ApplicationName uses the application's encryption: DescribeSnapshot returns it for such snapshots, but it must not be set with ApplicationName. Immutable after create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshot_encryption_configuration_description))
- `snapshot_format` (String) The format of the snapshot (CANONICAL). Sent to ImportSnapshot with ImportSourceConfiguration; with ApplicationName it may only be CANONICAL, the format CreateSnapshot produces. Returned by DescribeSnapshot. Immutable after create.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to apply to the snapshot. Applied at create time (with CreateSnapshot, or with TagResource right after ImportSnapshot) and updated in place with TagResource and UntagResource. Tag keys must not start with aws:. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `runtime_environment` (String) The runtime environment of the source application when the snapshot was taken with ApplicationName (CreateSnapshot), for example FLINK-1_20. Populated by DescribeSnapshot. Not returned for snapshots created with ImportSourceConfiguration (ImportSnapshot), which carry no runtime version.
- `snapshot_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot. Account-scoped: arn:<partition>:kinesisanalytics:<region>:<account>:snapshot/<SnapshotName>. Assigned by the service at create time and used as the resource's primary identifier.
- `snapshot_creation_timestamp` (String) The time at which the service created the snapshot, in ISO-8601 format. Populated by DescribeSnapshot.
- `snapshot_initiator` (String) Indicates whether the snapshot was initiated by the customer or by the service. Populated by DescribeSnapshot.
- `snapshot_initiator_operation` (String) The operation that initiated the snapshot. Populated by DescribeSnapshot.
- `snapshot_size_in_bytes` (Number) The size of the snapshot in bytes. Populated by DescribeSnapshot once the snapshot reaches READY.
- `snapshot_source_description` (Attributes) The source of the snapshot: the application it was taken from, or the Amazon S3 location it was imported from. Populated by DescribeSnapshot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshot_source_description))
- `snapshot_status` (String) The lifecycle status of the snapshot as reported by the service (CREATING, READY, DELETING, FAILED). Populated by DescribeSnapshot.

Optional:

- `import_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role that the service assumes to read the snapshot files from Amazon S3 (and to decrypt them, if they are encrypted with a customer managed key).
- `source_encryption_configuration` (Attributes) The encryption of the snapshot files in Amazon S3. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--import_source_configuration--source_encryption_configuration))
- `source_s3_prefix_location` (Attributes) The Amazon S3 bucket and key prefix that hold the snapshot files, for example the prefix an ExportSnapshot operation wrote them to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--import_source_configuration--source_s3_prefix_location))
- `source_type` (String) The type of storage the snapshot is imported from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_kinesisanalyticsv2_snapshot.example
  identity = {
    snapshot_arn = "snapshot_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `snapshot_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_kinesisanalyticsv2_snapshot.example
  id = "snapshot_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_kinesisanalyticsv2_snapshot.example "snapshot_arn"
```
